title: B&G pump startup request: is the job ready?
equipment: Bornquist pump startup request form (B&G pumps)

n1.text: Go through the startup request form with the contractor. Which answer is NO or N/A?

options.label: Equipment damaged, mechanical connections, mounting or grouting
System not filled or vented, no make-up water, gauges not installed
No power, cannot check rotation, BAS not operating, or no load for capacity verification

r_mech.cause: The equipment is not ready for startup.
fix: Have the contractor confirm the equipment is undamaged, all mechanical connections are made, it is mounted correctly with all hardware, and the base is grouted per the OEM manual.
If a question truly cannot be answered, write the reason in the comment section so service can decide whether startup is still possible.

r_hyd.cause: The hydronic system is not ready for startup.
fix: The system must be filled, vented and tested for leaks, make-up or domestic water connected and available, and gauges installed properly.

r_elec.cause: Electrical, controls or load conditions are not ready for startup.
fix: Electrical connections must be made and power available, rotation must be checkable, BAS connections made and operating, and a load must be establishable for capacity verification.
If crews arrive and the equipment is not ready they leave instructions and the startup is rescheduled; a one-hour labor charge applies to unsuccessful startup requests.

r_ready.cause: The job looks ready to schedule.
fix: Fill out the form for each pump (name, model, serial number, date code) and return it to the service department (service@bornquist.com, 773-774-2800).
Allow 48 hours for scheduling from the time the form is sent.
